detail.description: 在 `github.com/eclipse-keypont/crypto11/v2` 版本 `<= 2.0.0-rc8` （以及已弃用的 v1 模块路径 `github.com/eclipse-keypont/crypto11 <= 1.6.8`、`github.com/ThalesGroup/crypto11 <= 1.7.0-rc1` 和 `github.com/ThalesIgnite/crypto11 <= 1.2.5`），“SecretKey.NewGCM()”返回的“cipher.AEAD”将直接给定的任何随机数传递给“CK_GCM_PARAMS”，而不根据“NonceSize()”检查其长度，并接受空随机数。在接受零长度 GCM IV 的令牌上（SoftHSM2 会这样做），每个具有空随机数的“Seal”都会在同一 IV 下进行加密，重用密钥流并暴露 GHASH 身份验证密钥，从而允许伪造。另外，“Config.UseGCMIVFromHSM”会向令牌发送长度为零的 NULL IV，除非还设置了“GCMIVFromHSMControl.SupplyIvForHSMGCMEncrypt”，因此令牌无处可写它生成的 IV：在明文已加密后，具有非空随机数的“Seal”会发生恐慌，而具有空随机数的“Seal”会在空 IV 下返回密文，不会出现错误。另外，在 v1 线路上，HSM-IV 模式永远不会将令牌生成的 IV 复制回调用者，因此调用者保留自己的随机数，同时数据在另一个随机数下加密。
detail.title: CVE-2026-115407 漏洞

detail_original.description: In `github.com/eclipse-keypont/crypto11/v2` versions `<= 2.0.0-rc8` (and the deprecated v1 module paths `github.com/eclipse-keypont/crypto11 <= 1.6.8`, `github.com/ThalesGroup/crypto11 <= 1.7.0-rc1` and `github.com/ThalesIgnite/crypto11 <= 1.2.5`), the `cipher.AEAD` returned by `SecretKey.NewGCM()` passes whatever nonce it is given straight to `CK_GCM_PARAMS` without checking its length against `NonceSize()`, and accepts an empty nonce. On a token that accepts a zero-length GCM IV — SoftHSM2 does — every `Seal` with an empty nonce encrypts under the same IV, reusing the keystream and exposing the GHASH authentication key, which allows forgeries. Separately, `Config.UseGCMIVFromHSM` sends a NULL IV with length zero to the token unless `GCMIVFromHSMControl.SupplyIvForHSMGCMEncrypt` is also set, so the token has nowhere to write the IV it generates: a `Seal` with a non-empty nonce panics after the plaintext has already been encrypted, and a `Seal` with an empty nonce returns ciphertext under an empty IV without error. On the v1 line HSM-IV mode additionally never copies the token-generated IV back to the caller, so the caller keeps its own nonce while the data was encrypted under another one.
detail_original.title: CVE-2026-115407 漏洞
